claim_boundary: Revised PINDER-train-only antibody adaptation split following the frozen proof that complete single-linkage closure makes the original binary 15-25 percent design infeasible. The revised protocol does not relax the exact four-view 80/80 rule: it allows bridge entities and their PDB/exact-pair components to be discarded, while directly forbidding every authenticated 80/80 edge from crossing train and validation. The assignment remains provisional until the independent exhaustive Needleman-Wunsch audit reports zero crossings. This is not a performance evaluation, temporal test, structural split, or PLM pretraining leakage audit.
discard_policy: An antibody or antigen entity may be omitted to separate direct 80/80 similarity edges. A PDB-and-exact-pair connected component is retained only when all of its antibody and antigen endpoints are assigned to the same bucket; otherwise the complete component is discarded.

objective.primary: maximize retained unique exact antibody-antigen pairs across train and validation
objective.secondary: maximize validation exact pairs at fixed total retention

required_final_gate: independent exhaustive exact global four-view Needleman-Wunsch train-validation zero-crossing audit
